title: Cohere Rerank
description:
A reranking component powered by Cohere's Rerank API that improves 
search quality by reordering retrieved documents based on their 
relevance to a given query. Supports the rerank-english-v3.0 and rerank-v3.5 models 
with configurable top-K selection and minimum score thresholds.

input.description: Takes questions with retrieved documents and reranks them by relevance.

output.description: Produces reranked documents ordered by relevance score.
Produces an answer with reranked documents.
